title.narrative: YOUTH EDUCATION ACTIVITIES ON GENDER BASED VIOLENCE AND ASSOCIATED MENTAL HEALTH ISSUES (YEAMG)

description.narrative: The "Youth Education Activities on Gender Based Violence and Mental Health (YEAMG)" project, designed for the term 2024-2026, aims to address the prevalent issues of Gender-based Violence (GBV) and associated mental health challenges among Rwandan youth. Its objectives are to raise awareness of the impact of GBV on mental health, reduce stigma surrounding GBV, and promote mental health interventions. Key activities include, organizing anti-GBV events in communities and 9 campuses, educating through “Umuganda” national program, providing capacity building for community health workers and “Friends of Family”, conducting radio talks and TV shows, offering psychosocial support, engaging local communities and government ministries and youth initiatives, establishing a free helpline, and most importantly, educating Rwandan school and college students. By prioritising mental health and tackling GBV, the project seeks to empower youth and build a society free from gender-based violence and the associated mental health issues, contributing to a healthier and more sustainable Rwandan community.
